*Kusalattika, Dassanattika* (Patthana 23.7) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Structurally, it forms part of the complex combinatorial matrices of the *Paṭṭhāna*, cross-analyzing the causal and conditional relations of phenomena categorized under the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) and the vision/abandonment by seeing triad (*dassanattika*).
